title: plan.changed payload v1
description: An engine command (applyBillingPlan, reset, ...) that moved no credits, with its command and the whole mutation the engine decided: what a plan change or the cycle-end update after a renewal leaves in the log, so a replay runs every command. No postings: balances a plan moves are credit.* events with cause.

complete.description: Written by a handler that logs every engine command it runs (after atm 0.3.0), so a revision with no event in the log was a write of the grants row alone. Absent on what 0.3.0 wrote, which did not log some commands.
